subject_identity_preserved.rationale: The central elephant remains a large gray African elephant with visible white tusks across all shots. The scale and angle vary strongly, and shots 3-4 jump to an extreme close-up, but there is no clear replacement by a different animal.

background_coherent.rationale: The scene generally stays in a golden African savanna with acacia trees, distant hills, cloudy sky, and a safari-vehicle viewpoint. The main inconsistency is that shots 3-4 show close vehicle framing despite captions claiming no artificial structure, and the proximity changes abruptly.

which_cut_broke.how: The transition from shot 2 to shot 3 is the largest spatial jump, moving from a medium distant elephant view to an extreme close-up at the vehicle bars. It is abrupt but still plausibly the same elephant and location.

cheat_flags.rationale: Frames show distinct viewpoints, camera distances, and compositions rather than copied or frozen content. Captions partly collapse around elephant-in-savanna imagery, but the rendered shots include distinct actions and vehicle/filmmaker elements.
